keyVerseDR: "...there shall be joy in heaven upon one sinner that doth penance..." (Lk 15:7)

level1.title: The Lost Sheep
level1.story: A shepherd lost one sheep. He left the 99 and searched until he found it. God looks for us and rejoices when we come back!
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
questions: How does God show He loves us?
level1.prayer: Jesus, thank You for finding me. Amen.

activity.title: Find the lost
activity.intro: Find the hidden lost sheep and coin in the picture.

level2.title: Lost and Found
level2.story: Tax collectors and sinners came to listen to Jesus, and the Pharisees grumbled. Jesus told of a shepherd with a hundred sheep who leaves the ninety-nine to find the one that is lost. When he finds it, he lays it on his shoulders, rejoicing. He told of a woman who lost a silver coin and swept the house until she found it. Jesus said, "There shall be joy before the angels of God upon one sinner doing penance."
level2.keyLine: There shall be joy in heaven upon one sinner that doth penance.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: What do the three parables have in common?
How can you help someone 'come home'?
actions: Pray for someone far from God
level2.prayer: Good Shepherd, bring me home. Amen.
